title: Scalar vector integration in arbitrary Cartesian presentations
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a positive integer with N A=0, and B and B prime Noetherian schemes on which N is invertible. Let F and F prime be locally free modules of rank d on B and B prime. Write f:E(F)->B and f prime:E(F prime)->B prime for their vector-bundle projections, both admitting compactifications, with f prime quasi-compact. Let g:B prime->B and g prime:E(F prime)->E(F) form a Cartesian square g prime;f=f prime;g. Write Q_B=A_B(d)[2d], W=f^*Q_B, and W prime=f prime^*Q_Bprime. Let l:g prime^*W ~= W prime be the composite of the ordinary pullback square comparison g prime^*f^* ~= f prime^*g^* and f prime^* applied to the normalized finite Tate pullback comparison g^*Q_B ~= Q_Bprime. Let t_f:Rf_! W -> 1_B and t_fprime:Rfprime_! W prime -> 1_Bprime be the specified vector integrations followed by the degree-zero constant-to-tensor-unit isomorphisms. Let beta:g^*Rf_! -> Rfprime_!g prime^* be actual compact-support exchange and epsilon:g^*1_B ~=1_Bprime the pullback-unit comparison. Then beta_W followed by Rfprime_!(l), followed by t_fprime, equals g^*(t_f) followed by epsilon. No exceptional inverse image or purity-family hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Apply the proved canonical tensor-pullback integration base-change theorem to F0=g*F. Its coefficient comparison is the purityPullbackSquare comparison: prove equality by transporting leftDerivedUpperStarComp along the equality of square composites. This uses no invariance under arbitrary isomorphisms.

Compare the supplied pullback square with the canonical square using IsPullback.isoIsPullback. Its two projection equations give e.hom followed by the canonical top map equal to g prime and e.hom followed by the canonical bundle projection equal to the supplied bundle projection. Form its Cartesian square over the identity of B prime. Apply fixed-base presentation-isomorphism invariance of integration to this square.

Paste ordinary compact-support exchange for the canonical square with exchange for e. The inverse-image identity and composition unit laws remove the bottom identity. Naturality of exchange for the canonical coefficient map, followed by two inverse-image associativity equations and naturality of the composition comparison, identifies the resulting coefficient with the displayed purityPullbackSquare and Tate comparison. Substitute fixed-base invariance and canonical base change. This is a direct calculation of the actual morphisms, not an assumed compatibility for their transposes.

Postcompose with the specified constant-to-tensor-unit isomorphism. Apply ordinaryFiniteSingleUnitPullback_hom, proved from constantUnit_pullback and constantUnit_hom in a separate module to keep kernel type checking within the per-file budget. Functoriality and associativity give exactly the original equation.

theorem vectorIntegration_cartesianTrace
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {B B' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian B] [IsNoetherian B']
    (hB : IsUnit (N : Γ(B, ⊤))) (hB' : IsUnit (N : Γ(B', ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : B.Modules) (F' : B'.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] [F'.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    [HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)]
    [HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')]
    [QuasiCompact (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')]
    {g : B' ⟶ B}
    {g' : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B' d F' ⟶ VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F}
    (sq : IsPullback g' (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) g) :
    let l := purityPullbackSquare A sq (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA B d) ≪≫
      (RfPullback A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')).mapIso
        (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA
          (purityTwistTransport A N hN hA) g hB d)
    (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app
        (Etale.vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA B d F) ≫
      (RfShriek A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')).map l.hom ≫
      (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA B' hB' d F' ≫
        (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat A) B').hom) =
    (RfPullback A g).map (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA B hB d F ≫
      (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat A) B).hom) ≫
        (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat A) g).hom
